Worst meal I’ve had in Vietnam.
Dec 2019 • Solo
Worst meal I’ve had in Vietnam. Ordered the banh xeo, since the manager said it was great. When I came out, looked nothing like the picture, nor tasted like a traditional Vietnamese banh xeo. I’m Vietnamese and have been eating them my entire life. This thing was horrible and instead of pork, they substituted squid. They also chopped up the shrimp into tiny pieces. The fish sauce dipping sauce also had ground black pepper. No Vietnamese person restaurant would serve traditional nuoc mam with black pepper. Horrible food! Could hardly stomach three bites and they couldn’t give a damn. Never asked me if it always ok or not. Not sure if they’re trying to cater to the taste of the increased Korean tourists, but from a Vietnamese prospective, it was horrible!!!
